title: Cheesy Baked {p} and {v} Casserole
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and grease an 8-inch baking dish.
Sauté the {v} in a skillet with a little oil 4 to 5 minutes, until crisp-tender, and spread it in the dish.
Whisk the {p} with a splash of milk, the {spice} and a pinch of salt until smooth. Sprinkle the {sauce} over the vegetables, then pour the egg mixture over the top.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes, until the center is set and puffed and the casserole is {doneness}.
Cool 5 minutes, cut into squares, and serve with the {s}.
tip: Use plenty of vegetables and a smaller square, and swap half the cheese for extra herbs.
